meta.note: Los hechos provienen de los artículos originales enlazados. La IA solo traduce y resume; no genera noticias.

es.title: Noticias de Copyright e Inteligencia Artificial
es.subtitle: Notas publicadas por medios reales de la industria, con liga al artículo original. Sin noticias inventadas.

items.title: Italian Competition Watchdog Launches Suno Investigation ‘Over Unfair Terms,’ Says ‘The Contractual Provisions on Copyright Deserve Particular Attention’
items.summary: La Autoridad Italiana de Competencia ha iniciado una investigación formal contra Suno, el generador de música IA, por supuestos términos contractuales injustos y cláusulas de derechos de autor que requieren especial atención.

items.title: Sony Music’s AI Slop and Deepfakes Crackdown Intensifies — Soundalike Track Removal Requests Reportedly Top 250,000
items.summary: Sony Music ha intensificado su lucha contra deepfakes de IA, enviando más de 250 000 solicitudes de eliminación de pistas que imitan a artistas a diversas plataformas, según un informe del Financial Times.

items.title: Dr. Luke’s Copyright Battle Against a South Dakota Broadcaster Enters Settlement—But Those Aren’t the Only Sides Battling Over Infringement Claims
items.summary: El caso de derechos de autor de Dr. Luke contra una emisora de Dakota del Sur avanza hacia un acuerdo, mientras un tercero solicita intervención alegando una participación en la autoría de varias canciones.

items.title: Major publishers tell US Supreme Court they must intervene in termination rights ruling that “threatens the licensing of copyrighted works throughout the world”
items.summary: Los principales editores musicales y BMG han presentado una nueva solicitud ante la Corte Suprema de EE. UU. en la disputa sobre derechos de terminación que involucra al compositor Cyril Vetter, advirtiendo sobre posibles impactos en licencias.

items.title: A US appeals court has rejected a ‘fair use’ defense over AI training. What does it mean for the labels’ fight with Suno?
items.summary: Un tribunal de apelaciones de EE. UU. rechazó la defensa de ‘uso justo’ en el entrenamiento de IA, lo que podría influir en la estrategia de los sellos discográficos frente a Suno.

items.title: Japanese court says voice is protected by publicity rights; US appeals court says AI training is not fair use
items.summary: Una corte japonesa determinó que los derechos de publicidad protegen la voz de los artistas contra clones de IA no autorizados, mientras que una corte de apelaciones estadounidense rechazó la defensa de ‘uso justo’ para el entrenamiento de IA, destacando enfoques legales divergentes.

items.title: New Suno live music division to help make it the “first creative entertainment platform”
items.summary: Suno, la plataforma de generación musical IA, incorporó Songkick tras su acuerdo de licencia con Warner Music Group, creando una división de música en vivo que busca combinar IA con descubrimiento de conciertos.

items.title: AI Lost Its First Fair Use Appeal. Suno Should Be Worried.
items.summary: La IA perdió su primera apelación de ‘uso justo’, lo que sugiere que Suno podría enfrentar desafíos legales significativos en futuros casos de derechos de autor y deberá reconsiderar sus estrategias de entrenamiento y distribución.

items.title: Suno AI y GEMA: la batalla por los derechos de autor que puede redefinir el negocio de la música para la IA
items.summary: El conflicto entre Suno AI y GEMA sobre derechos de autor plantea la posibilidad de redefinir cómo la industria musical gestiona la creación y explotación de obras generadas por inteligencia artificial.

items.title: Historic ruling on 'fair use' and AI may help Nashville songwriters
items.summary: Una sentencia histórica sobre ‘uso justo’ y IA podría beneficiar a los compositores de Nashville al establecer precedentes que faciliten la protección de sus obras frente a tecnologías de inteligencia artificial.

items.title: Suno hires Ticketmaster’s Michael Chua to lead its live music team, including Songkick
items.summary: Suno ha contratado a Michael Chua, ex de Ticketmaster, para dirigir su equipo de música en vivo, supervisando operaciones que incluyen la plataforma de descubrimiento de conciertos Songkick y expandir la integración de IA en eventos en directo.

items.title: Elon Musk says Grok Bot will use Suno’s AI music models, alongside Anthropic’s Claude and Midjourney
items.summary: Elon Musk anunció que Grok Bot empleará los modelos de música IA de Suno, junto a Claude de Anthropic y Midjourney, aunque Suno aún no dispone de una API pública y está evaluando su lanzamiento.

tip.title: Sample sin licencia no se arregla con 'menos de 7 segundos'
tip.body: No existe una cantidad de segundos legalmente segura. Cualquier fragmento reconocible puede ser infracción, y necesitas dos permisos: el de la grabación (sello) y el de la composición (editorial).

en.title: Copyright & Artificial Intelligence News
en.subtitle: Stories published by real industry outlets, each linked to its original article. No invented news.

items.title: Italian Competition Watchdog Launches Suno Investigation ‘Over Unfair Terms,’ Says ‘The Contractual Provisions on Copyright Deserve Particular Attention’
items.summary: The Italian Competition Authority has opened a formal probe into Suno, the AI music generator, alleging unfair contractual terms and copyright provisions that merit particular scrutiny in the context of ongoing legal challenges.

items.title: Sony Music’s AI Slop and Deepfakes Crackdown Intensifies — Soundalike Track Removal Requests Reportedly Top 250,000
items.summary: Sony Music is ramping up its AI deepfake crackdown, filing over 250,000 sound‑alike takedown requests with multiple platforms, as reported by the Financial Times to protect artists' rights and prevent unauthorized reproductions.

items.title: Dr. Luke’s Copyright Battle Against a South Dakota Broadcaster Enters Settlement—But Those Aren’t the Only Sides Battling Over Infringement Claims
items.summary: Dr. Luke’s copyright lawsuit against a South Dakota broadcaster moves toward settlement, and a third party has filed an intervention request claiming authorship interest in several of the disputed songs.

items.title: Major publishers tell US Supreme Court they must intervene in termination rights ruling that “threatens the licensing of copyrighted works throughout the world”
items.summary: Major music publishers and BMG have filed a new brief with the U.S. Supreme Court in the termination‑rights case concerning songwriter Cyril Vetter, warning that the outcome could affect licensing of copyrighted works worldwide.

items.title: A US appeals court has rejected a ‘fair use’ defense over AI training. What does it mean for the labels’ fight with Suno?
items.summary: A U.S. appeals court dismissed the ‘fair use’ defense for AI training, a decision that may affect how record labels confront Suno in future copyright disputes by shaping legal arguments and enforcement tactics.

items.title: Japanese court says voice is protected by publicity rights; US appeals court says AI training is not fair use
items.summary: A Japanese court ruled that publicity rights shield performers’ voices from unauthorized AI clones, and a U.S. appeals court denied the ‘fair use’ defense for AI training, highlighting divergent legal approaches.

items.title: New Suno live music division to help make it the “first creative entertainment platform”
items.summary: Suno, the AI music generator, added concert‑discovery platform Songkick through its licensing deal with Warner Music Group, establishing a live‑music division that aims to merge AI creation with gig discovery.

items.title: AI Lost Its First Fair Use Appeal. Suno Should Be Worried.
items.summary: AI lost its first fair‑use appeal, indicating that Suno may face significant legal hurdles in upcoming copyright disputes and may need to rethink its training and distribution strategies to comply with evolving jurisprudence.

items.title: Suno AI y GEMA: la batalla por los derechos de autor que puede redefinir el negocio de la música para la IA
items.summary: The dispute between Suno AI and GEMA over copyright raises the prospect of reshaping how the music industry handles creation and exploitation of works produced by artificial intelligence and licensing frameworks worldwide.

items.title: Historic ruling on 'fair use' and AI may help Nashville songwriters
items.summary: A landmark ruling on ‘fair use’ and AI may aid Nashville songwriters by creating legal precedents that strengthen protection of their compositions against artificial‑intelligence‑driven infringements and clarify the scope of permissible sampling.

items.title: Suno hires Ticketmaster’s Michael Chua to lead its live music team, including Songkick
items.summary: Suno appointed Michael Chua, formerly of Ticketmaster, to head its live‑music division, overseeing operations that include the concert‑discovery platform Songkick and aiming to broaden AI integration in live events for artists and audiences worldwide.

items.title: Elon Musk says Grok Bot will use Suno’s AI music models, alongside Anthropic’s Claude and Midjourney
items.summary: Elon Musk stated that Grok Bot will utilize Suno’s AI music models together with Anthropic’s Claude and Midjourney, even though Suno currently lacks a public API and is considering its release.

tip.title: There is no safe 'under 7 seconds' rule for samples
tip.body: No number of seconds is legally safe. Any recognizable fragment can infringe, and you need two clearances: the master recording (label) and the composition (publisher).
